description: PAA (Path-Aligned Attribution, audit-artifact-E593) with deepseek-flash as its auditor backbone. The artifact's own paa.run runs in its own venv; the adapter swaps paa.llm._run_backend for an OpenAI-compatible transport to the guard, disables paa.llm.subprocess, and applies the declared runtime patch P1-tooldesc-marker. Each stage = zero-cost prepare (sample + integrity + prompt sizes) + guarded run + zero-cost fidelity report. Set AUDITOR_ARTIFACTS_ROOT (its paa/ child holds .venv and src/audit-artifact-E593) and AUDITOR_OUT_ROOT; paid stages also need AUDITOR_LAB_ENV.

defaults.fidelity: backbone-substituted: deepseek-flash replaces Claude Sonnet 5 via Claude Code CLI v2.1.172 effort low (paper Table 12, App. C.1); temperature 0.0 and thinking disabled (lab convention); --contract on, rules 0.3; declared runtime patch P1-tooldesc-marker (paa.eu._ACTION_TOOL_MARK /input_benign/tools/ -> /benign_input/tools/); not an exact reproduction

s0-dry.description: Plumbing dry run: 1 unit (the smallest-prompt S1 unit) through the guard to local Ollama. Not evidence.

estimate.requests: 1-6 (contract, trace, adjudicate; up to 2 attempts each)
estimate.tokens: local Ollama; prompt truncated to the model's context
estimate.usd: 0 real; the guard prices Ollama requests notionally at DeepSeek rates (usd_is_notional), and one 66k-char trace prompt reserves about 0.013 notional, so the notional ceiling is 0.10

s0-dry.compares_to: nothing; checks the route, the patch, certificate stamping and both ledgers

s1.description: 3 Codex-corpus units drawn from the S2 sample (gold Block IO03/IO04, gold Block other, gold Pass): measure real DeepSeek tokens per unit, JSON-contract compliance and finish reasons before S2.

estimate.requests: about 12 (4 per unit, the Sonnet-5 median; 18 max)
estimate.tokens: central 185k input + 21k output; upper 436k + 147k (UNVERIFIED; prepare_receipt.json estimate)
estimate.usd: central 0.08, upper 0.31 at the 2026-09-30 snapshot 0.30/1.20 per M (UNVERIFIED)

s1.compares_to: per-unit verdicts in the shipped Sonnet-5 predictions (baselines/v4-baseline-exp-results/v4-codex-r1/paa-claude/predictions.jsonl) and gold; n=3, descriptive only

s2.description: 60-unit fidelity sample of the Codex corpus (30 gold Block incl. 5 IO03 + 5 IO04, 30 gold Pass; proportional within gold class, one unit per trajectory pair, sha256 order with tag paa-deepseek-fidelity-v1).

estimate.tokens: central 3.03M input + 0.42M output; upper 7.14M + 2.95M (UNVERIFIED; prepare_receipt.json estimate)
estimate.usd: central 1.41, upper 5.68 at the 2026-09-30 snapshot (UNVERIFIED); the 5.00 cap stops the pathological upper case

s2.compares_to: recall/FBR vs paper Table 2 (Codex corpus, PAA Sonnet 5: .860/.077; tool-call view Table 3 .875/.071) and the Table 16 pair-bootstrap CIs in exp/bootstrap-ci/data/ci_estimates.csv (recall .8255-.8923, FBR .0585-.0974); per-unit agreement, kappa and McNemar against the shipped Sonnet-5 predictions on the same 60 units (OPEN-7 draft threshold 0.80); GPT-5.5 predictions as a second reference
